div.div: Capacity. With create_cluster = true the module registers one capacity provider backed by an EC2 Auto Scaling group (t4g.medium by default), so tasks run on container instances you own. The task definition also declares FARGATE compatibility, but the module never registers a Fargate capacity provider: reaching Fargate means create_cluster = false and pointing capacity_provider_name at your own cluster. See the Fargate note in the guide before planning on it.

div.div: Configure both directions. Flows 7, 9, and 10 reach Palo Alto Networks, and none of them carries prompt or completion content. Flow 5 is where that content lands, inside your own account. Outbound alone leaves a gateway that serves traffic but never appears in Strata Cloud Manager.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 900px; margin-left: 3px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #666666;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #666666; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-style: italic; white-space: nowrap;

div.div: An AWS VPC endpoint service can only be created against a Network Load Balancer. If you chose an ALB (because server_mode = "all" needs host-based routing), inbound PrivateLink needs an NLB placed in front of that ALB, provisioned outside this module.
